President Donald Trump on Tuesday hinted at a development that could upend the Democratic Party’s momentum heading into Election Day when he called on Americans to watch for a “midterm surprise.”

Trump issued the vague warning to Democrats in a Truth Social post claiming voters are energized to cast their ballots for Republicans on Nov. 3.

“My Rally crowds and enthusiasm are unbelievable! Nobody has ever seen anything like it. We are flipping races all over the place. The Fake News knows it, but they don’t want to be truthful with their viewers. It’s all happening! The Dumocrats never counted on this. Thanks you to the great Networks that are covering the Rallies in full. They are being rewarded with BIG RATINGS. Watch for the ‘Midterm Surprise!’” Trump stated in the post.
